SURVIVES: census.gov/wholesale's intention-to-revise notice, read verbatim this session, dates the 2023/2024 AIES wholesale restatement to 2026-10-26 10:00 EDT, so this print's data has an EIGHTEEN-DAY SHELF LIFE and is the last ordinary monthly wholesale release on the pre-AIES basis. NEW THIS SESSION, and the reason this edition is not its 11-09 sibling: August is the QUIETEST reference month in the GDPNow archive — 6 of 6 August editions moved the change-in-inventory-investment contribution by under 0.10pp (median 0.0280pp, max 0.0652pp), against September's 0.1261pp median and 50%. The mechanism is that a quarter-END reference month must post in the first week of a new nowcast round (n=26, 0.0864pp, 57.7% quiet) while a mid-quarter month posts late into a well-fed one (n=52, 0.0451pp, 86.5%, permutation p=0.024) — which reproduces the 11-09 sibling's classifier-collapse finding at Jaccard 0.846 and renames the variable.
